parameters.name: ArtifactId
parameters.description:
The ID of the artifact.

Call [ListArtifacts](~~469993~~) to obtain the artifact ID.

parameters.name: ArtifactVersion
parameters.description:
The version of the artifact.

Call [ListArtifactVersions](~~469995~~) to obtain the artifact version.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long.
